Aadhaar Authentication Capacity to Significantly Increase

India's Aadhaar authentication capacity is set to increase from the current 100 million daily verifications to 250-300 million, according to UIDAI CEO Amit Kumar Mishra. This expansion aims to accommodate growing demand for Aadhaar-based services. The increase in capacity is expected to facilitate a larger volume of transactions and verifications across various platforms utilizing the Aadhaar system.
